scam-text.title: Fake Canada Post text message
scam-text.summary: Do not pay anything. This text is a scam trying to steal your card details.

steps.instruction: Tap Report Junk above the text.
steps.detail: This will safely delete the message and report the scammer.

reasons: Canada Post never asks for payments or personal information by text message.
The link address ends in .info instead of the real Canada Post website.
It rushes you with a 24-hour deadline to make you panic.
do_not: Do not enter any bank card numbers or personal details.
Do not reply to the message.
how_to_close: Tap 'Report Junk' on your screen to delete and block it.

video-call.title: Starting a video call
video-call.summary: You can start a video call right from this screen. Just tap the small video camera icon near the top right.

steps.instruction: Tap the video camera icon at the top.
steps.detail: It sits right next to Ali's name bar on the right side.

steps.instruction: Tap Call if a confirmation message pops up.
steps.detail: Once Ali answers, you will see each other on screen.

virus-popup.title: Fake Microsoft security alert scam
virus-popup.summary: Do not call that number. This is a fake pop-up trying to trick you into paying scammers.

steps.instruction: Click the X at the very top right to close.
steps.detail: This shuts down the fake webpage completely.

steps.instruction: Press Alt and F4 together if it stays open.
steps.detail: On your keyboard, holding Alt and tapping F4 will force the webpage to close.

reasons: Microsoft never puts phone numbers in security pop-ups or asks you to call them.
The website address at the top is not Microsoft; it is a fake site created by scammers.
It uses scary threats about stolen banking info to make you panic and call right away.
do_not: Do not call the 1-888 phone number.
Do not click 'Call Now' or 'Cancel' inside the blue screen.
Do not allow anyone who answers that number to connect to your computer.
how_to_close: Click the X at the top right corner of your browser window.
If the mouse is stuck or the window refuses to close, hold down your computer's power button for 10 seconds to turn it off safely.

virus-popup.next_hint: Let me know if the window closed safely or if it is still stuck on your screen.

storage-full.title: Phone Storage Is Full
storage-full.summary: Your phone does not have room left to save new photos. We can open Settings to see what is filling it up.

steps.detail: This will take you to your phone storage page.

steps.instruction: Look at what is taking up space.
steps.detail: Usually videos, unused apps, or old messages take up the most room.

steps.instruction: Delete unwanted videos or unused apps.
steps.detail: You can also open the Photos app and empty your Recently Deleted album.

fix.what_went_wrong: The camera stopped working because your phone has no free storage space left.
fix.likely_cause: Saved photos, large videos, or unused apps have filled up your device memory.

storage-full.next_hint: After you tap Settings, send me a screenshot of what appears.

wifi-settings.title: Connect to Wi-Fi
wifi-settings.summary: You are in the right place! We just need to open your network settings to find her Wi-Fi name.

steps.detail: It is the very first option near the top with the blue circle.

steps.instruction: Tap Internet or Wi-Fi on the next screen.
Find your daughter's Wi-Fi network name and tap it.
Type her Wi-Fi password and tap Connect.

wifi-settings.next_hint: Tap Network & internet, then send a new screenshot if you want help finding her Wi-Fi name.
